process_steps.description: Primary recovery: continuous disk-stack centrifugation followed by depth and sterile filtration; clarifies the culture and defines the feed to Protein A. Forms no product-quality attribute.

source_references.quote: removes cells and particulates but does not form, remove or modify any product-quality attribute

statements.statement_text: PCP-004 defines the Stage 1 characterization of the A-Mab harvest and clarification operation (Step 4).
Harvest and clarification has no impact on the product-quality CQAs, which pass through unchanged.

source_references.quote: no impact on the product-quality CQAs

statements.statement_text: Each parameter is studied one factor at a time across its characterization range.
The operation is characterized against process-performance measures because it sets no CQA.

source_references.quote: sets or modifies no product-quality CQA

statements.statement_text: The operation defines the clarified feed delivered to Protein A capture.

source_references.quote: defines the feed to Protein A
